subject: POC orchestration: hands-on lab timeline & sample gating
messages:
From: Sam Nelson <sam.nelson@atelier-ai.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff + hands-on lab — sample and timing questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to kick off the PoC and schedule a hands-on working session focused on prompt review, routing checks, and a short burst load test. High level:
- Goal: validate prompt fidelity and routing policies with 1k token prompts and a 30 req/s burst window.
- Deliverables we want during session: prompt/eval review, routing matrix verification, and a short load run with our golden prompts.

We can make time next week (Nov 9–13). Prefer mornings PT. I attached a brief scope doc (Atelier_POC_Scope.pdf) with our requirements and a sample prompt set.

Two quick questions before we lock a slot:
1) What format do you prefer for the sample payloads (CSV / NDJSON)?
2) Any redaction guidance we should follow for customer PII in the prompts?

Also looping in our POC engineer (cc'd privately).

Thanks,
Sam Nelson
Head of Integrations | Atelier AI

Attachment: Atelier_POC_Scope.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc:
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood POC kickoff + hands-on lab — sample and timing questions

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sam's note. They want a hands-on lab that includes prompt review, routing verification, and a quick load burst.

Proposed internal plan:
- Marissa: lead prompt/eval walkthrough and live coaching on prompt reformulation.
- Karthik: routing smoke tests + KV/cache warmup plan; bring routing-smokeplan.xlsx.
- Naomi: coordinate calendar and runbook, sign-off on redaction guidance.

Two candidate windows I suggested to Sam in quick DM:
A) Tue Nov 9, 09:30–12:00 PT (3 hours)
B) Thu Nov 11, 10:00–13:00 PT (3 hours)

We should ask Atelier to provide samples as CSV with an id, prompt_text, expected_label, and a redaction flag. Also ask them to populate a small evaluation set (~150 examples) and a golden set for the burst (~50 prompts).

Action: can you confirm you can own the routing checklist and the sample ingestion steps? I can draft a short runbook and redaction checklist.

— Naomi
Director, Solutions Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Nelson <sam.nelson@atelier-ai.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff + hands-on lab — sample and timing questions

Hi Sam — great to hear from you. Nov 11 10:00–13:00 PT works well for our team if that slot is open for you.

On the artifacts: CSV is best for the hands-on flow. Could you send two files:
- prompts_for_review.csv (id, prompt_text, expected_output_short, redaction_needed true/false)
- golden_burst.csv (id, prompt_text, expected_latency_ms, expected_token_count)

Redaction guidance (short): remove/replace direct identifiers (emails, full credit card numbers, SSNs). For protected entities, replace with tags like <PERSON_NAME> and leave context intact. I'll attach a one-page template for how we prefer the handshake (sample-handshake-template.csv).

During the session we'll do:
1) Prompt & eval review with live edits
2) Routing policy walkthrough (Karthik will verify model selection & fallback rules)
3) Warmup/caching + 2-minute 30 req/s burst run against a canary endpoint.

Please upload samples to the Drive link or attach to email. Also confirm if Atelier wants replay logs retained by Redwood or removed after validation (we have options for ephemeral retention).

Thanks — I'll prepare the prompt workshop deck and a short runbook.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-handshake-template.csv (CSV, 2KB)

Thanks Marissa — apologies, travel conflict came up and I need to move the session. Can we shift to Nov 12, 09:30–12:30 PT? Same agenda.

I've uploaded the two CSVs to our shared Drive folder and added a short redaction note there (link below). The files are: prompts_for_review.csv and golden_burst.csv. Quick note on redaction: some examples reference pseudonymous customer IDs we prefer to keep; I've marked those with redaction_needed=false where context matters. To: Sam Nelson <sam.nelson@atelier-ai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: PoC working session — Nov 12 09:30–12:30 PT (rescheduled)

Sam — Nov 12 09:30–12:30 PT is confirmed on our side. Thank you for the prompt files. Next steps and owners below: 

1) Sample ingestion (naomi_feldman): I'll pull prompts_for_review.csv and validate schema; will return an ingestion report by EOD Nov 4.
2) Prompt workshop (marissa_cole): prepare live edit deck and evaluation checklist.
3) Routing & load (karthik_iyer): prepare routing-smokeplan.xlsx and the canary endpoint for a 2-minute 30 req/s burst; please confirm model variants to test.
4) Redaction policy (naomi_feldman): For now we'll accept redaction_needed=false where context is essential; any direct identifiers must be removed or tokenized. I'll upload a small redaction-checklist.md to the Drive.
5) Replay retention (naomi_feldman): we can retain logs for 7 days and set auto-delete; please confirm if 7 days is okay.

Please reply with a quick ack and any conflicts. I'll share a short runbook with exact connection details and the canary endpoint by Nov 9.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Solutions Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redaction-checklist.md (MD, 1KB)
